title: Lesson 13: Rate Limiting & Backpressure — js-tools
desc: A fixed window lets 200 requests per second through when the limit is 100 — measured right at the window boundary, and no configuration fixes it; the four algorithms barely differ in speed but differ more than tenfold in memory; INCR and EXPIRE issued as separate commands leave 20 of 200 keys stuck with no TTL, permanently blocking those users; three replicas sharing one Lua script hold a global limit to within 0.13%; and refusal must be early and selective, never a 5xx.
